```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
setDTthreads(1L)
code <- '/project/spott/cshan/fiber-seq/code'
out <- normalizePath(params$out, mustWork=TRUE)
dest <- file.path(out, 'analysis/single_tf_adjusted')
required <- c('cre_covariates.tsv.gz','motif_sample_counts.tsv.gz','motifs.tsv.gz','samples.tsv')
missing <- required[!file.exists(file.path(out,required))]
if(length(missing)) stop('Missing ',paste(missing,collapse=', '),
  '. Run prepare for samples.tsv; FIMO for motifs.tsv.gz; count then combine for count/covariate tables.')
stopifnot(params$min_fibers > 0, params$cores >= 1, params$top_n >= 0)
dir.create(file.path(dest,'plots'),recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
source(file.path(code,'parsing_functions/plotting_functions.r'))
write_tsv <- function(x,name) fwrite(x,file.path(dest,name),sep='\t',na='NA')
save_plot <- function(p,name,w=10,h=6) ggsave(file.path(dest,'plots',name),p,width=w,height=h,limitsize=FALSE)
```

This report is descriptive: there are no statistical tests, p-values, confidence
intervals or multiple-testing corrections. `single_tf_adjusted` refers to the
existing donor-adjusted co-accessibility labels, not adjustment of TF frequencies.
For each motif, donor and set, bound frequency is total bound fibers divided by
total informative fibers across motif-bearing CREs. Only donors with a nonzero
denominator in both sets contribute to paired summaries. Zero denominators are
missing, never zero frequencies. All eligible CREs contribute to motif presence.

### Motif, read and footprint overlap criteria

- A covered read must cover the **entire CRE in aligned blocks**, not just its
  outer alignment span.
- Accessibility requires **one same-fiber FIRE element overlapping at least 50%
  of the CRE**, with the overlap counted only in aligned bases.
- Binding requires an accessible read with a FiberHMM record and a **10–80 bp
  footprint with per-block score >=50**. The footprint must lie completely inside
  a same-fiber FIRE element, and one footprint must overlap **>=50% of the motif
  instance's bases**. This is a fraction of motif length, not footprint length;
  overlaps from separate footprints are not added together.
- Any qualifying instance gives one bound observation per **CRE × motif × read**.
  Missing FiberHMM records are excluded from the denominator; an observed record
  without qualifying support is accessible-unbound. Motif presence simply means
  at least one saved FIMO hit in that CRE, without a footprint requirement.
- Example plots additionally require a read spanning the complete plotting
  window. Window-centering support uses these full-span molecules in the initial
  CRE-centered window, followed by rebuilding the final motif-centered window.

```{r inputs, eval=params$run_frequencies}
cre <- fread(file.path(out,'cre_covariates.tsv.gz'))
stopifnot(all(c('CRE_ID','chrom','start','end','CRE_class','set_adjusted','n_accessible',
  'n_informative','prop_act','length','motif_count') %in% names(cre)),!anyDuplicated(cre$CRE_ID))
cre <- cre[set_adjusted %in% c('background','co-access') &
  n_accessible>=params$min_fibers & n_informative>=params$min_fibers]
cre[,set:=set_adjusted]
stopifnot(nrow(cre)>0,all(is.finite(cre$prop_act)),all(cre$length>0),!anyNA(cre$CRE_class))
write_tsv(cre,'eligible_cres.tsv.gz')
write_tsv(cre[,.(n_CREs=.N,median_prop_act=median(prop_act),median_length=median(length),
  median_motif_count=median(motif_count)),by=set],'set_balance.tsv')
write_tsv(cre[,.N,by=.(CRE_class,set)],'set_balance_CRE_class.tsv')
hits <- fread(file.path(out,'motifs.tsv.gz'),select=c('CRE_ID','motif_id','TF_label'))
labels <- unique(hits[,.(motif_id,TF_label)])
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(labels$motif_id),!anyNA(labels$TF_label))
instances <- unique(hits[,.(CRE_ID,motif_id)])
ids <- sort(labels$motif_id)
mc <- fread(file.path(out,'motif_sample_counts.tsv.gz'),
  select=c('CRE_ID','motif_id','sample_name','donor','n_accessible','n_informative','n_bound'))
samples <- fread(file.path(out,'samples.tsv'))
stopifnot(nrow(samples)==31L,!anyDuplicated(samples$sample_name),
  setequal(unique(mc$sample_name),samples$sample_name),
  all(mc$donor == samples$donor[match(mc$sample_name,samples$sample_name)]),
  !anyNA(mc),all(mc$n_bound>=0),all(mc$n_bound<=mc$n_informative),
  all(mc$n_informative<=mc$n_accessible))
mc <- merge(mc[CRE_ID %in% cre$CRE_ID],cre[,.(CRE_ID,set)],by='CRE_ID')
donor_counts <- mc[,.(n_bound=sum(n_bound),n_informative=sum(n_informative),
  n_CREs=uniqueN(CRE_ID),n_informative_CREs=uniqueN(CRE_ID[n_informative>0])),by=.(motif_id,donor,set)]
donor_counts <- merge(CJ(motif_id=ids,donor=unique(samples$donor),set=c('background','co-access')),
  donor_counts,by=c('motif_id','donor','set'),all.x=TRUE)
for(nm in c('n_bound','n_informative','n_CREs','n_informative_CREs'))
  set(donor_counts,which(is.na(donor_counts[[nm]])),nm,0)
donor_counts[,frequency:=fifelse(n_informative>0,n_bound/n_informative,NA_real_)]
write_tsv(donor_counts,'single_tf_donor_frequencies.tsv.gz')
rm(mc,hits);invisible(gc())
```

```{r frequencies, eval=params$run_frequencies}
frequency_summary <- function(id) {
  d <- donor_counts[motif_id==id]
  paired <- dcast(d,donor~set,value.var='frequency')
  paired <- paired[is.finite(background) & is.finite(`co-access`)]
  ans <- data.table(motif_id=id,status=if(nrow(paired)) 'ok' else 'no_paired_donors',
    n_paired_donors=nrow(paired),
    background_frequency=if(nrow(paired)) median(paired$background) else NA_real_,
    coaccess_frequency=if(nrow(paired)) median(paired[['co-access']]) else NA_real_,
    median_paired_difference=if(nrow(paired)) median(paired[['co-access']]-paired$background) else NA_real_)
  # No pseudocount: zero/zero is undefined; positive/zero is infinite.
  ratio <- paired[['co-access']]/paired$background
  ans$median_paired_log2_ratio <- if(any(!is.na(ratio))) median(log2(ratio),na.rm=TRUE) else NA_real_
  pr <- data.table(motif_id=id)
  present <- instances[motif_id==id,CRE_ID]
  for(g in c('background','co-access')) {
    prefix <- if(g=='co-access') 'coaccess' else g
    z <- d[set==g];n <- sum(z$n_informative)
    ans[[paste0(prefix,'_n_bound')]] <- sum(z$n_bound)
    ans[[paste0(prefix,'_n_informative')]] <- n
    ans[[paste0(prefix,'_pooled_frequency')]] <- if(n>0) sum(z$n_bound)/n else NA_real_
    c <- cre[set==g]
    pr[[paste0(prefix,'_n_CREs')]] <- nrow(c)
    pr[[paste0(prefix,'_n_with_motif')]] <- sum(c$CRE_ID %in% present)
    pr[[paste0(prefix,'_fraction')]] <- if(nrow(c)) mean(c$CRE_ID %in% present) else NA_real_
  }
  pr[,difference:=coaccess_fraction-background_fraction]
  list(occupancy=ans,presence=pr)
}
results <- parallel::mclapply(ids,frequency_summary,mc.cores=as.integer(params$cores))
stopifnot(!any(vapply(results,inherits,logical(1),'try-error')))
occupancy <- merge(rbindlist(lapply(results,`[[`,'occupancy')),labels,by='motif_id')
presence <- merge(rbindlist(lapply(results,`[[`,'presence')),labels,by='motif_id')
top <- occupancy[status=='ok' & median_paired_difference>0][order(-median_paired_difference,motif_id)]
top <- head(top[!duplicated(TF_label)],params$top_n)
write_tsv(occupancy,'single_tf_occupancy.tsv.gz')
write_tsv(presence,'single_tf_presence.tsv.gz')
write_tsv(top,'top5_motifs.tsv')
saveRDS(list(params=params,occupancy=occupancy,presence=presence,top=top,session=sessionInfo()),
  file.path(dest,'single_tf_results.rds'))
knitr::kable(top)

```{r logos, eval=params$run_frequencies}
# Scanner uses this path by default; retain its environment override if supplied.
meme <- Sys.getenv('LCL_TF_MOTIFS','/project/spott/cshan/annotations/JASPAR2026_CORE_vertebrates_non-redundant_pfms_meme.txt')
read_meme <- function(path,ids) {
  lines <- readLines(path); starts <- grep('^MOTIF ',lines); result <- list()
  for(i in starts) {
    id <- strsplit(trimws(lines[i]),'\\s+')[[1]][2]
    if(!id %in% ids) next
    j <- which(seq_along(lines)>i & grepl('^letter-probability matrix:',lines))[1]
    width <- as.integer(sub('.* w=\\s*([0-9]+).*','\\1',lines[j]))
    mat <- as.matrix(read.table(text=paste(lines[j+seq_len(width)],collapse='\n')))
    stopifnot(ncol(mat)==4,all(is.finite(mat)),all(mat>=0),all(abs(rowSums(mat)-1)<1e-3))
    result[[id]] <- mat/rowSums(mat)
  }
  stopifnot(all(ids %in% names(result)));result
}
draw_information_logo <- function(mat,max_width) {
  heights <- mat*pmax(0,2+rowSums(mat*log2(pmax(mat,.Machine$double.xmin))))
  font <- systemfonts::match_fonts('sans',weight='bold')
  glyph <- systemfonts::glyph_info(c('A','C','G','T'),path=font$path)
  outlines <- systemfonts::glyph_outline(glyph$index,path=font$path,size=100)
  pieces <- list()
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(mat))) {
    bottom <- 0
    for(j in order(heights[i,])) {
      h <- heights[i,j];if(h<1e-5) next
      g <- as.data.table(outlines[outlines$glyph==j,])
      g[,`:=`(x=i-.45+.9*(x-min(x))/diff(range(x)),
        y=bottom+h*(y-min(y))/diff(range(y)),base=c('A','C','G','T')[j],letter=paste(i,j))]
      pieces[[length(pieces)+1L]] <- g;bottom <- bottom+h
    }
  }
  d <- rbindlist(pieces)
  p <- ggplot()+scale_fill_manual(values=c(A='#2b8c4b',C='#2878b5',G='#e3a018',T='#d94b45'),guide='none')+
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(.5,max_width+.5))+scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,2),breaks=c(0,2))+
    labs(x=NULL,y='bits')+theme_fiberseq()+theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(),axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
  if(nrow(d)) p <- p+geom_polygon(data=d,aes(x,y,group=letter,subgroup=contour,fill=base),rule='evenodd')
  p
}
if(nrow(top)) {
  matrices <- read_meme(meme,top$motif_id)
  saveRDS(list(path=normalizePath(meme),md5=tools::md5sum(meme),matrices=matrices),file.path(dest,'logo_matrices.rds'))
  h <- merge(top[,.(motif_id,TF_label,background_frequency,coaccess_frequency)],
    presence[,.(motif_id,background_fraction,coaccess_fraction)],by='motif_id')
  h <- h[match(top$motif_id,motif_id)]
  h[,label:=paste0(TF_label,' (',motif_id,')')]
  long <- melt(h,id.vars=c('motif_id','TF_label','label'),measure.vars=c('coaccess_fraction','background_fraction',
    'background_frequency','coaccess_frequency'),variable.name='metric',value.name='value')
  long[,`:=`(value=100*value,label=factor(label,levels=rev(h$label)))]
  limits <- c(floor(min(long$value)),ceiling(max(long$value)))
  if(diff(limits)==0) limits <- limits+c(-.5,.5)
  heat <- ggplot(long,aes(metric,label,fill=value))+geom_tile()+
    geom_text(aes(label=sprintf('%.1f%%',value),color=value>mean(limits)),size=3)+
    scale_color_manual(values=c('FALSE'='#222222','TRUE'='white'),guide='none')+
    scale_fill_distiller(palette='Blues',direction=1,limits=limits,name='%')+
    scale_x_discrete(labels=c('Co-access\npresence','Background\npresence','Background\nbound','Co-access\nbound'),position='top')+
    labs(x=NULL,y=NULL)+theme_fiberseq()+theme(axis.line=element_blank())
  logos <- wrap_plots(lapply(top$motif_id,function(id) draw_information_logo(matrices[[id]],max(vapply(matrices,nrow,integer(1))))),ncol=1)
  p <- (heat+logos)+plot_layout(widths=c(1.8,3))+plot_annotation(
    title='Top TFs by frequency difference: motif presence and median donor bound frequency',
    caption='Presence: all eligible CREs. Bound: medians across paired donors, conditional on motif-bearing, informative CREs.')
  save_plot(p,'top5_heatmap_logos.pdf',15,max(4,nrow(top)*1.1));print(p)
} else {
  p <- ggplot()+annotate('text',x=0,y=0,label='No TFs have a positive median paired donor frequency difference')+theme_void()
  save_plot(p,'top5_heatmap_logos.pdf');print(p)
}
```

Assumptions and limitations: rankings use positive median within-donor differences,
with ties broken by motif ID and one motif retained per TF label. No significance
claim is made. Donors contribute equally to the median; within each donor, CREs
are weighted by their informative fiber counts. Pooled frequencies are also
reported. The two marginal medians need not differ by the median paired difference.
The MEME path uses the FIMO wrapper default or `LCL_TF_MOTIFS`; historical scan
overrides must be supplied again because scan command provenance was not retained.
Residual confounding by accessibility, CRE class, length and motif copy number
remains. Related motifs can move together. Background is limited to the tested
pair universe, and shared CREs/pairs/fibers create dependence. Example regions
are illustrations, not tests. Missing FiberHMM records never count as unbound.

Example plotting conventions: deciles are calculated across all eligible CREs
(duplicate quantile boundaries are collapsed). For each ranked TF, select the
most informative unused co-access CRE whose decile has an unused background,
then the most informative background in that decile; ties use CRE ID. CRE IDs
are never reused. Windows use the notebook's 1-based inclusive midpoint +/-500 bp.
Anchor support is counted among initial-window full-span molecules. All 31 LCLs
enter assembly, with only samples contributing retained molecules sent to feature
extraction. Accessible molecules missing FiberHMM records and molecules failing
full CRE alignment are excluded from displayed states and recorded in the audit.
The cluster-profile helper's internal `time` field carries motif state, not time.
The cCRE track uses the same annotation BED as the notebook. The CRE track uses
the smallest saved adjusted FDR among valid pairs passing the raw coverage filter;
this is a pre-existing co-accessibility annotation, not a new TF significance test.

## Example regions

Run this section after the frequency outputs exist. `run_frequencies = FALSE`
reuses those outputs; `run_examples = FALSE` skips read-level extraction and plots.
Selection, motif centering, final-window rebuilding, and panels 3A–3E are all
implemented here in R. The existing LCL shell extractor only slices indexed files.

```{r example-functions, eval=params$run_examples, message=FALSE}
# Descriptive top-TF examples; all analysis stages run directly in R.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(Matrix)
  library(GenomicRanges); library(Rsamtools); library(igraph)
  library(ComplexHeatmap); library(cowplot); library(grid); library(patchwork)
})
setDTthreads(1L)
code <- '/project/spott/cshan/fiber-seq/code'
out <- normalizePath(params$out, mustWork=TRUE)
dest <- file.path(out,'analysis/single_tf_adjusted')
example_root <- file.path(dest,'example_regions')
source(file.path(code,'parsing_functions/parsing_footprints_functions.r'))
source(file.path(code,'clustering_methods/Leiden_Manhattan/leiden_manhattan_functions.r'))
source(file.path(code,'parsing_functions/plotting_functions.r'))

stopifnot(file.exists(extract_script))
state_levels <- c('bound','accessible-unbound','inaccessible')
state_colors <- c(bound='#d95f02','accessible-unbound'='#3274a1',inaccessible='#bdbdbd')

# Import the same named Rmd chunks as the notebook, preserving their environments.
reference_lines <- readLines(file.path(code,'fire_frequency/05_vis_fire_freq.Rmd'))
reference_chunk <- function(name) {
  a <- grep(paste0('^```\\{r[[:space:]]+',name,'([,[:space:]]|\\})'),reference_lines)
  stopifnot(length(a)==1)
  b <- which(seq_along(reference_lines)>a & grepl('^```[[:space:]]*$',reference_lines))[1]
  paste(reference_lines[seq.int(a+1,b-1)],collapse='\n')
}
reference_style <- new.env(parent=globalenv())
reference_style$input_dir <- dest
reference_style$sample_names <- character()
eval(parse(text=reference_chunk('top10_examples_setup')),reference_style)
eval(parse(text=reference_chunk('top10_examples_functions')),reference_style)
for(nm in c('example_theme_settings','window_breaks','example_title','stack_rows','molecule_tracks',
            'interval_track_inputs','bar_width','bar_gap','molecule_xlim','plot_molecules','fp_cols'))
  assign(nm,get(nm,reference_style),envir=globalenv())
example_title <- function(ex) paste(ex$selection_TF,ex$set,paste0(ex$chrom,':',ex$start,'-',ex$end))
example_dir <- function(ex) file.path(example_root,ex$example_id)
example_figure_path <- function(ex,panel,description)
  file.path(example_dir(ex),paste0(ex$example_id,'_',panel,'_',description,'.pdf'))

# Tabix inputs and footprint rules mirror count(); all intervals here are BED half-open.
slice_bed <- function(path,chrom,start,end) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(path),file.exists(paste0(path,'.tbi')))
  con <- TabixFile(path);open(con);on.exit(close(con))
  if(!chrom %in% seqnamesTabix(con)) return(list())
  strsplit(scanTabix(con,param=GRanges(chrom,IRanges(max(1L,start+1L),end)))[[1]],'\t',fixed=TRUE)
}
blocks <- function(f,footprint=FALSE) {
  sizes <- as.numeric(strsplit(f[11],',',fixed=TRUE)[[1]])
  offsets <- as.numeric(strsplit(f[12],',',fixed=TRUE)[[1]])
  stopifnot(length(sizes)==as.integer(f[10]),length(offsets)==length(sizes))
  keep <- rep(TRUE,length(sizes))
  if(footprint) {
    scores <- as.numeric(strsplit(f[13],',',fixed=TRUE)[[1]])
    stopifnot(length(scores)==length(sizes))
    keep <- sizes>=10 & sizes<=80 & scores>=50
  }
  data.frame(start=as.numeric(f[2])+offsets[keep],end=as.numeric(f[2])+offsets[keep]+sizes[keep])
}
overlap_length <- function(b,start,end) sum(pmax(0,pmin(b$end,end)-pmax(b$start,start)))
classify_fibers <- function(ex,hits,samples) {
  rows <- support <- footprints <- list()
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(samples))) {
    s <- samples[i,]
    al <- slice_bed(s$blocks_path,ex$chrom,ex$start,ex$end)
    fi <- slice_bed(s$elements_path,ex$chrom,ex$start,ex$end)
    tf <- slice_bed(s$tf_path,ex$chrom,ex$start,ex$end)
    fire <- split(fi,vapply(fi,`[`,character(1),4))
    calls <- split(tf,vapply(tf,`[`,character(1),4))
    for(f in al) {
      rid <- f[4];b <- blocks(f)
      if(overlap_length(b,ex$start,ex$end)!=ex$end-ex$start) next
      fs <- fire[[rid]]
      accessible <- any(vapply(fs,function(z) overlap_length(b,max(ex$start,as.numeric(z[2])),
        min(ex$end,as.numeric(z[3]))) >= .5*(ex$end-ex$start),logical(1)))
      observed <- length(calls[[rid]])>0
      fp <- bind_rows(lapply(calls[[rid]],blocks,footprint=TRUE))
      if(nrow(fp)) fp <- fp[vapply(seq_len(nrow(fp)),function(j)
        any(vapply(fs,function(z) as.numeric(z[2])<=fp$start[j] && fp$end[j]<=as.numeric(z[3]),logical(1))),logical(1)),]
      bound <- FALSE
      qualified <- paste(s$sample_name,rid,sep='::')
      if(accessible && observed && nrow(fp)) {
        for(j in seq_len(nrow(hits))) {
          yes <- pmin(fp$end,hits$end[j])-pmax(fp$start,hits$start[j])>=.5*(hits$end[j]-hits$start[j])
          if(any(yes)) {
            bound <- TRUE
            support[[length(support)+1L]] <- data.table(instance_id=hits$instance_id[j],RID=qualified)
          }
        }
      }
      if(nrow(fp)) footprints[[length(footprints)+1L]] <- data.table(RID=qualified,start=fp$start,end=fp$end)
      rows[[length(rows)+1L]] <- data.table(RID=qualified,sample_name=s$sample_name,
        accessible=accessible,has_FiberHMM=observed,
        motif_state=if(!accessible) 'inaccessible' else if(!observed) NA_character_ else if(bound) 'bound' else 'accessible-unbound')
    }
  }
  r <- rbindlist(rows);stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(r$RID))
  u <- if(length(support)) unique(rbindlist(support)) else data.table(instance_id=character(),RID=character())
  list(states=r,support=u,footprints=rbindlist(footprints))
}

region_for <- function(ex) data.frame(chr=ex$chrom,start=ex$window_start-1L,end=ex$window_end,
  analysis_start=ex$window_start,analysis_end=ex$window_end,width=ex$window_end-ex$window_start+1L,
  region_id=ex$example_id,region_type='CRE',annotation=example_title(ex))
assemble <- function(ex,samples) assemble_region_m6a(sample_table=lcl_region_samples(region_for(ex),samples),
  region=region_for(ex),full_span=TRUE,reuse=FALSE)

make_tracks <- function(ex,samples,result,classification) {
  active <- samples[samples$sample_name %in% result$assignments$sample_name,,drop=FALSE]
  paths <- extract_region_results(active$sample_name,
    data.frame(chr=ex$chrom,start=ex$window_start,end=ex$window_end),ex$example_id,example_root,extract_script,
    regenerate=TRUE)
  tracks <- load_region_results(data.frame(chr=ex$chrom,start=ex$window_start,end=ex$window_end),
    active$sample_name,paths,nucleosome_source='ft',fiberHMM_size_breaks=c(10,30,60,80),verbose=FALSE)
  ids <- paste(tracks$rids_df$sample_name,tracks$rids_df$RID,sep='::')
  for(nm in c('reads','rids_df','fire','fps','fps_infire','nucs')) {
    if(is.null(tracks[[nm]]) || !nrow(tracks[[nm]])) next
    tracks[[nm]]$RID <- factor(paste(tracks[[nm]]$sample_name,tracks[[nm]]$RID,sep='::'),levels=ids)
  }
  missing <- setdiff(result$assignments$RID,ids)
  if(length(missing)) stop(length(missing),' clustered molecules lack plotting tracks in ',ex$example_id)
  # Use exact same-fiber FIRE-element containment from the count rules, rather
  # than relying on segmentation-derived FIRE polishing for displayed footprints.
  if(nrow(tracks$fps)) {
    fp <- as.data.table(tracks$fps)
    elements <- list()
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(active))) {
      lines <- slice_bed(active$elements_path[i],ex$chrom,ex$window_start-1L,ex$window_end)
      if(length(lines)) elements[[i]] <- rbindlist(lapply(lines,function(f)
        data.table(RID=paste(active$sample_name[i],f[4],sep='::'),start=as.numeric(f[2]),end=as.numeric(f[3]))))
    }
    elements <- if(length(elements)) rbindlist(elements) else
      data.table(RID=character(),start=numeric(),end=numeric())
    contained <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(fp)),function(i) {
      el <- elements[RID==as.character(fp$RID[i])]
      any(el$start<=fp$start[i] & fp$end[i]<=el$end)
    },logical(1))
    tracks$fps_infire <- as.data.frame(fp[contained & !is.na(class)])
  }
  add_read_groups(tracks,setNames(as.character(result$assignments$motif_state),result$assignments$RID),
    'motif_state',group_levels=state_levels,verbose=FALSE)
}

plot_tracks <- function(ex,zoom=FALSE) {
  hits <- as.data.frame(motifs[CRE_ID==ex$CRE_ID & motif_id==ex$motif_id])
  hits$start <- hits$start+1L;hits$label <- ex$selection_TF
  window <- if(zoom) c(max(ex$window_start,ex$anchor_start-50),min(ex$window_end,ex$anchor_end+50)) else
    c(ex$window_start,ex$window_end)
  motif_plot <- plot_interval_track(hits,window,fill_col='score',row_col='label',geometry='segment',
    color_scale=scale_colour_gradientn(colours=c('#ECDFFF','#AB7DFF','#3155FF'),limits=motif_score_limits,name='FIMO score'),
    labels=list(x=NULL,y=NULL),theme=theme_fiberseq())
  tested <- data.frame(start=ex$start+1L,end=ex$end,label=ex$set,value=-log10(max(ex$best_pair_fdr,.Machine$double.xmin)))
  cre_plot <- plot_interval_track(tested,window,fill_col='value',row_col='label',geometry='segment',linewidth=2.5,
    color_scale=scale_colour_gradient(low='#FEE5D9',high='#F43B2B',limits=cre_fdr_limits,name='-log10(pair FDR)'),
    labels=list(x=NULL,y=NULL),theme=theme_fiberseq())
  tr <- interval_track_inputs(ex)
  tr <- tr[tr$class!='tested FIRE region',,drop=FALSE]
  cc <- plot_interval_track(tr,window,fill_col='class',row_col='y',geometry='rect',clip_intervals=TRUE,
    color_scale=scale_fill_manual(values=CCRE_COLORS,name='cCRE class'),
    scales=list(y=scale_y_continuous(breaks=tr$y,labels=tr$label)),
    labels=list(x=paste(ex$chrom,'position (bp)'),y=NULL),theme=theme_fiberseq())
  list(motif=motif_plot,cre=cre_plot,ccre=cc)
}
plot_footprint_panels <- function(accessibility,molecules,ex,n_bars,n_groups,n_molecules,subtitle) {
  tr <- plot_tracks(ex)
  p <- wrap_plots(accessibility,tr$motif,tr$cre,tr$ccre,molecules,ncol=1,
    heights=c(max(1,n_groups),.6,.5,.8,max(2,.025*n_molecules)))+
    plot_annotation(title=example_title(ex),subtitle='LCLs pooled; groups and sidebars show motif state or Leiden cluster')
  list(plot=p,height=5+max(1,n_groups)+max(2,.025*n_molecules))
}
# The shared cluster-profile helper calls its grouping field `time`. Only its
# local plotting environment adapts that field; no reference file is modified.
lcl_heatmap <- function(res,...) {
  extra <- list(...)
  a <- res$assignments
  a <- a[order(a$cluster,a$start,a$RID),,drop=FALSE]
  plot_read_heatmap(res,layout='genomic',sample_colors=state_colors,sample_label_column='motif_state',
    main=example_title(res$example),use_raster=FALSE,draw=isTRUE(extra$draw),
    heatmap_options=list(left_annotation=ComplexHeatmap::rowAnnotation(
      cluster=a$cluster,motif_state=a$motif_state,
      col=list(cluster=cluster_palette(levels(res$assignments$cluster)),motif_state=state_colors))))
}
cluster_profiles <- plot_tf_cluster_profiles
profile_env <- new.env(parent=environment(cluster_profiles))
profile_env$plot_read_heatmap <- lcl_heatmap
environment(cluster_profiles) <- profile_env

main <- function() {
  needed <- c('cre_covariates.tsv.gz','motif_sample_counts.tsv.gz','motifs.tsv.gz','samples.tsv')
  missing <- needed[!file.exists(file.path(out,needed))]
  if(length(missing)) stop('Missing ',paste(missing,collapse=', '),'; run prepare -> FIMO -> count -> combine.')
  if(!file.exists(file.path(dest,'top5_motifs.tsv'))) stop('Run the single_tf stage first.')
  top <- fread(file.path(dest,'top5_motifs.tsv'))
  dir.create(example_root,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  if(!nrow(top)) {message('No positive-frequency TFs selected; no examples to plot.');return(invisible(NULL))}
  cre <- fread(file.path(dest,'eligible_cres.tsv.gz'))
  samples <- as.data.frame(fread(file.path(out,'samples.tsv')))
  stopifnot(nrow(samples)==31L,!anyDuplicated(samples$sample_name))
  motifs <<- fread(file.path(out,'motifs.tsv.gz'))[motif_id %in% top$motif_id]
  breaks <- unique(quantile(cre$prop_act,seq(0,1,.1),names=FALSE))
  cre[,decile:=if(length(breaks)>1) as.integer(cut(prop_act,breaks,include.lowest=TRUE)) else 1L]
  selected <- list();used <- character();selection_status <- list()
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(top))) {
    id <- top$motif_id[i]
    pool <- cre[CRE_ID %in% motifs[motif_id==id,CRE_ID] & !CRE_ID %in% used]
    common <- intersect(pool[set=='co-access',decile],pool[set=='background',decile])
    if(!length(common)) {
      selection_status[[i]] <- data.table(motif_id=id,status='no_unused_decile_matched_pair');next
    }
    co <- pool[set=='co-access' & decile %in% common][order(-n_informative,CRE_ID)][1]
    bg <- pool[set=='background' & decile==co$decile][order(-n_informative,CRE_ID)][1]
    pair <- rbind(co,bg)
    pair[,`:=`(motif_id=id,selection_TF=top$TF_label[i],rank=i)]
    pair[,example_id:=paste(gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]','_',selection_TF),chrom,start,end,sep='_')]
    selected[[i]] <- pair;used <- c(used,pair$CRE_ID)
    selection_status[[i]] <- data.table(motif_id=id,status='selected')
  }
  fwrite(rbindlist(selection_status),file.path(example_root,'selection_status.tsv'),sep='\t')
  examples <- rbindlist(selected)
  if(!nrow(examples)) return(invisible(NULL))
  # Best = smallest saved adjusted FDR among raw-coverage-passing valid pairs.
  pairs <- fread(file.path(out,'pairs.tsv.gz'),select=c('CRE1','CRE2','set_adjusted','fdr_adj'))
  pairs <- pairs[set_adjusted!='excluded' & is.finite(fdr_adj)]
  best <- rbind(pairs[,.(CRE_ID=CRE1,fdr_adj)],pairs[,.(CRE_ID=CRE2,fdr_adj)])[,.(best_pair_fdr=min(fdr_adj)),by=CRE_ID]
  examples <- merge(examples,best,by='CRE_ID',all.x=TRUE,sort=FALSE)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(examples$best_pair_fdr))
  setorder(examples,rank,set)
  examples[,`:=`(window_start=as.integer(floor((start+1+end)/2))-500L,
    window_end=as.integer(floor((start+1+end)/2))+500L)]
  fwrite(examples,file.path(example_root,'selected_example_regions.tsv'),sep='\t')
  ccre <- fread('/project/spott/cshan/annotations/GRCh38-cCREs.bed',header=FALSE)
  reference_style$ccre <- data.frame(chr=ccre$V1,start=ccre$V2+1L,end=ccre$V3,
    ccre_id=ccre$V4,ccre_class=ccre$V6)
  motif_score_limits <<- range(motifs$score)
  if(diff(motif_score_limits)==0) motif_score_limits <<- motif_score_limits+c(-.5,.5)
  cre_fdr_limits <<- c(0,max(1,-log10(pmax(examples$best_pair_fdr,.Machine$double.xmin))))
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(examples))) {
    ex <- as.data.frame(examples[i]);dir.create(example_dir(ex),recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
    message('Example ',i,'/',nrow(examples),': ',example_title(ex))
    hits <- motifs[CRE_ID==ex$CRE_ID & motif_id==ex$motif_id]
    classification <- classify_fibers(ex,hits,samples)
    fwrite(classification$states,file.path(example_dir(ex),'fiber_states.tsv.gz'),sep='\t',na='NA')
    # Select anchor using initial-window full-span, informative accessible molecules.
    initial <- assemble(ex,samples)
    support <- classification$support[RID %in% initial$rids_df$RID]
    candidates <- merge(hits,support[,.(support=.N),by=instance_id],by='instance_id',all.x=TRUE)
    candidates[is.na(support),support:=0L]
    setorder(candidates,-support,-score,start,end,strand)
    fwrite(candidates,file.path(example_dir(ex),'motif_center_candidates.tsv'),sep='\t')
    if(candidates$support[1]<1) stop('No supported motif in initial window: ',ex$example_id)
    anchor <- candidates[1];center <- as.integer(floor((anchor$start+1+anchor$end)/2))
    ex$anchor_start <- anchor$start+1L;ex$anchor_end <- anchor$end
    ex$window_start <- max(1L,center-500L);ex$window_end <- center+500L
    dat <- assemble(ex,samples)
    states <- classification$states
    keep <- dat$rids_df$RID %in% states[!is.na(motif_state),RID]
    metadata <- dat$rids_df[keep,,drop=FALSE];mat <- dat$met_mat[keep,,drop=FALSE]
    if(nrow(mat)<3 || ncol(mat)<2) stop('Too few retained molecules/sites: ',ex$example_id)
    result <- leiden_manhattan_cluster(mat,metadata,ex$window_start,ex$window_end,
      window_size=0,k_neighbors=10,resolution=1,seed=1)
    result$site_met_mat <- mat;result$region <- region_for(ex);result$example <- ex
    result$assignments$motif_state <- factor(states$motif_state[match(result$assignments$RID,states$RID)],levels=state_levels)
    result$assignments$time <- result$assignments$motif_state
    result$assignments$original_RID <- metadata$original_RID[match(result$assignments$RID,metadata$RID)]
    stopifnot(!anyNA(result$assignments$motif_state))
    final_support <- classification$support[instance_id==anchor$instance_id & RID %in% result$assignments$RID]
    fwrite(final_support,file.path(example_dir(ex),'anchor_final_support.tsv'),sep='\t')
    if(!nrow(final_support)) stop('Anchor lost support after re-centering: ',ex$example_id)
    tracks <- make_tracks(ex,samples,result,classification)
    saveRDS(result,file.path(example_dir(ex),'pooled_leiden.rds'))
    saveRDS(tracks,file.path(example_dir(ex),'retained_molecule_tracks.rds'))
    fwrite(result$assignments,file.path(example_dir(ex),'molecule_assignments.tsv.gz'),sep='\t')
    fwrite(ex,file.path(example_dir(ex),'final_window.tsv'),sep='\t')
    a <- result$assignments
    rows <- stack_rows(a[order(a$motif_state,a$start,a$RID),],'motif_state')
    labels <- setNames(paste0(state_levels,' (n=',table(factor(a$motif_state,levels=state_levels)),')'),state_levels)
    molecules <- plot_molecules(rows,molecule_tracks(tracks),ex,'motif_state',labels,
      bar_cols='motif_state',bar_palette=state_colors,legend_extra=state_levels)
    profile <- plot_group_profile(tracks$pileup,group_col='motif_state',style='area',y_col='smooth_frac',
      facet_col='motif_state',fill_colors=state_colors,colors=state_colors,
      window=c(ex$window_start,ex$window_end),labels=list(y='m6A fraction',x=NULL),theme=theme_fiberseq())
    panel <- plot_footprint_panels(profile,molecules,ex,1,length(state_levels),nrow(a),'')
    ggsave(example_figure_path(ex,'panel3A','motif_state_molecules'),panel$plot,width=10,height=panel$height,limitsize=FALSE)
    ht <- grid::grid.grabExpr(lcl_heatmap(result,draw=TRUE),width=9,height=10)
    ggsave(example_figure_path(ex,'panel3B','leiden_heatmap'),ht,width=9,height=10)
    cluster_profiles(ex,reference_result=function(ex) result,show_reads=function(result) invisible(NULL),
      example_dir=example_dir,example_figure_path=example_figure_path,plot_footprint_panels=plot_footprint_panels,
      molecule_tracks=molecule_tracks,add_read_groups=add_read_groups,stack_rows=stack_rows,plot_molecules=plot_molecules,
      time_cols=state_colors,time_levels=state_levels,example_theme_settings=example_theme_settings,
      window_breaks=window_breaks,example_title=example_title)
    graph <- plot_knn_graph(result,main=paste(example_title(ex),'by Leiden cluster'),seed=1)
    ggsave(example_figure_path(ex,'panel3D','knn_by_cluster'),graph,width=9,height=7)
    nodes <- graph$layers[[2]]$data
    nodes$color_group <- a$motif_state[match(nodes$RID,a$RID)]
    graph$layers[[2]]$data <- nodes
    graph <- graph+scale_color_manual(values=state_colors,drop=FALSE)+
      labs(title=paste(example_title(ex),'by motif state'),color='Motif state')
    ggsave(example_figure_path(ex,'panel3D','knn_by_motif_state'),graph,width=9,height=7)
    tr <- plot_tracks(ex,zoom=TRUE)
    ggsave(example_figure_path(ex,'panel3E','motif_locations'),wrap_plots(tr,ncol=1)+
      plot_annotation(title=example_title(ex)),width=10,height=5)
  }
  saveRDS(sessionInfo(),file.path(example_root,'R_sessionInfo.rds'))
}
